outcome: Prove workspace write confinement with an operating-system boundary in a privileged container or virtual machine, with a positive control.
non_goals: Do not claim OS-enforced confinement from a convention check alone
Do not make the test depend on privileges that the shared CI runner cannot grant
Do not retry a varying result into a pass

transitions.reason: the M3 gate does not require OS-enforced confinement because the shared runner cannot grant the privilege; the M4 gate does
